🔴 Chip stocks are falling out of bed. The $SOX briefly broke below 11,000 Tuesday and is down over 25% from its June high.

💾 $SKHY hit a US all-time low, $MU has lost over $450 billion in market value since its June record high, and $SNDK has been cut by more than half.

🟢 But the S&P 500 equal-weight index hit a record high Tuesday, nearly three-quarters of S&P 500 stocks are up in July, and the advance-decline line also set a record.

⚠️ As long as those broader breakouts hold, the chip crash remains a sector problem. A reversal would show the damage is spreading.

$F just delivered a Q2 earnings beat, and upped its 2026 guidance thanks to strong profit growth.

Ford's full-year adjusted EBIT is now $10 billion to $11 billion, up from $8.5 billion to $10.5 billion.

Watches and jewelery outperformed other divisions, with organic growth reaching 9% for the half and 11% in the second quarter, lifting revenue to €5.22bn and profit 9% higher to €831m.
